source.title: Consecrated Sharpening Stones
source.objective: ProgressIf you bring me eight necrotic runes from the Scourge invaders, I can give you a consecrated sharpening stone. It should be of great help in your battle against the minions of the Lich King.
source.completion: Thank you, <name>. Here are your consecrated sharpening stones. Use them prudently.
